Negative settled BTC and ETH ETF flows, together with declining proxy breadth, could produce a more synchronized downside move than the mixed forecast.

A fade or retest remains credible; the observed bounce does not establish sustained recovery.
falsification_conditions: Repeated subsequent candles show sustained BTC and ETH advances, persistent ETH/BTC strength and contemporaneous improvement across the observed alt-capitalization buckets.
BTC and ETH reverse their latest hourly gains while repeated spot selling and worsening breadth establish synchronized downside rather than leader-versus-laggard divergence.
missing_evidence: Follow-through after the supplied 09:00 UTC hourly close.

supporting_evidence: The latest hour shows BTC up approximately 0.17%, ETH up 0.60% and ETH/BTC up 0.38%, with taker-buy quote shares of approximately 53% and 58% for BTC and ETH.
Price and open interest rose together, but hourly OI increases were modest and long/short ratios were close to one; this supports participation without establishing a durable trend.

Earlier spot microstructure showed negative taker imbalances, especially for BTC, and negative depth imbalances, especially for ETH. The later positive candle conflicts with that earlier selling snapshot rather than proving recovery.
